raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review of only the listed pinned inputs. Read the packet, case, complete rubric/rules/addendum/method and adapter; verified pinned hashes and PNG headers, and read all five listed native-evidence manifests before image viewing. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so those receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and semantically viewed all 15 exact poster assets through tools.view_image with detail original, emitted through functions.exec, in packet order M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. Completed that entire sequence before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage or making any judgment or score. Retained all 60 actual first readings. Subsequently made one exact native-view revisit of M1 and one of M4 solely for genuine date/hours punctuation-class ambiguities; both entries in each image use that same single actual revisit, and all four remain unresolved. There were 15 initial poster opens plus these two native revisit opens; no source image opens because no sources were supplied. No peer, producer explanation, unlisted embedded path, replacement asset, generated view, session ID or tool-event ID was used. Actual native dimensions verified as 1672x941, usage as 720x405 and thumbnail as 320x180 for every member. Native 16:9 correctness uses the predeclared 0.5-pixel height-edge rounding exception, not mathematical exactness. Semantic viewing and freshness here are truthful critic attestations; runner provenance is not invented.

issues: Date and hours range-bar classes remain unresolved after one exact native revisit; no required glyph is inferred from the supplied copy. The other ten entries are legible, and no duplicate or additional print was observed.

hierarchy.location: top-left title/slogan, upper-right date block and lower paragraph

hierarchy.location: bold lower paragraph relative to upper title
hierarchy.observation: The paragraph reads as another display block rather than supporting prose; the first sentence and second sentence have almost the same visual authority as the promotional line.

typography.location: two full-width explanatory lines beneath the shelf
typography.observation: The long explanation is set in heavy gothic with little differentiation from slogan and information. Clean glyphs are present, but the dense, long bold lines flatten the typographic roles.

typography.location: paragraph and bottom two information groups
typography.observation: Everything can be read, including the URL, but sustained bold weight makes the long explanatory read visually tiring and the invitation/care lines insufficiently differentiated.

space.location: three broad horizontal bands

space.location: bottom access/invitation and care/URL
space.observation: Two clearly aligned bottom groups retain outer margins and adequate separation; no required text is cut by the frame.

image_material.location: plant shelf, pots and supporting hand
image_material.observation: Painted leaves have identifiable shapes and varied variegation; pots sit on a shared shelf plane with compatible shadows, and the hand supports the right pot convincingly.

image_material.location: branching tree, palm and round-leaf plant
image_material.observation: Different foliage structures and pot surfaces are coherent enough to survive close inspection rather than collapsing into undifferentiated green texture.

emotion_control.location: friendly illustrated assortment and warm shelf
emotion_control.observation: Healthy, varied plants and warm clay/yellow tones convey a welcoming opportunity to pick a plant, with a gentle handling gesture rather than a hard retail pitch.

emotion_control.location: broad line of plants
emotion_control.observation: The continuous assortment supplies inviting abundance and a clear public-market identity despite the over-heavy type.

ai_slop.location: shelf plane, pot bases and right hand
ai_slop.observation: The objects have intelligible contacts and shared support; no obvious contradictory pot construction or arbitrary decorative add-on appears in the main band.

ai_slop.location: different leaf silhouettes and plain background
ai_slop.observation: The visual variation is botanical and task-related, without pseudo-symbols, unrequested badges or random texture masquerading as content.

evidence.location: paragraph and paired lower visit groups relative to M4
evidence.observation: At use size the common photo-plus-information-panel reading logic is especially evident: main title followed by Latin, slogan, explanation and a pale lower participation area. evidence.location: right explanation and vertical visit stack compared with M2/M3/M4

Diversity is 3, not an average of per-image ratings. The close M1/M4 system and recurring title/body/information roles prevent five genuinely distinct whole visual systems, despite meaningful crop and spatial differences in M2/M3/M5.
M2 hierarchy/typography and M3 content_form/emotion_control remain below 4; the strong members do not cancel those low records.
